Periscope FAQs

  1. Help Center
  2. Using Periscope

Important

Soon, we’re making changes to the broadcasts we store. If you have broadcasts recorded through X or Periscope, we encourage you to download them soon or risk losing them. For more info on what changes we’re making or how to download your broadcasts, read below.

Periscope apps are no longer live as of March 31, 2021.

We’ve sunset the Periscope iOS and Android apps as of March 31, 2021 as we discussed here. You will not be able to create a new account, broadcast live, or purchase coins. Thank you for being a vibrant part of our Periscope community. We look forward to having you join the conversation on X.

What are the available options for live broadcast on X?

People can broadcast on X using X Live within compose by selecting the in-app camera icon. Additionally, brands, publishers and creators can go live on X by using Media Studio.

Can I link my Periscope account to X?

You can no longer link a Periscope account to X. If you do not have a X account, you will need to create one.

Can I download an archive of my Periscope broadcasts and data?

Soon, we’ll be making changes to how we store broadcasts. For a limited time you can download your Periscope broadcasts here. You can also download your broadcasts on X via your X data archive which can be found in the settings of your X account.

How do I download my broadcasts?

To download your Periscope broadcasts:

  1. Log into your Periscope account on the web and visit the download dashboard page
  2. Select Send Data Request below the first of three dots you’ll see at the top of the dashboard
  3. Once your request is complete, scroll down to see a list of your broadcasts
  4. Click the Download button next to any broadcast you wish to download locally to your computer.

Note: The Download links are valid for 7 days. Once the links expire, you can click Send Data Request again, which will include your most recent data.

To download your X broadcasts:

  1. Log into your X account
  2. From the nav menu select Settings and Privacy
  3. Navigate to Your Account and select Download an archive of your Data
  4. Select Request Archive

Note: Once the request has been received it may take 24 hours or longer for X to send you the ZIP file containing your data.

What happened to the Super Broadcaster Program?

The Super Broadcaster program has ended. The ability to purchase coins for tipping favorite broadcasters is also unavailable. Thank you to the creators who made this a vibrant community throughout its duration.

I am a Super Broadcaster. What should I do with my stars?

You should request to cash out all your stars before April 30, 2021. Read more on the Super Broadcaster program here.

I am not a Super Broadcaster yet, but I meet the criteria to apply, what should I do?

The Super Broadcaster program has ended and new applications are no longer being accepted.

What are my options if I have coins I haven’t used yet?

Following the sunset of Live broadcasts on March 31, 2021, the ability to use coins to send Super Hearts to your favorite broadcasters is no longer available.

Will my periscope followers be transferred over to my X Account?

We don’t automatically transfer followers from your Periscope account to your X account. Followers will have to manually re-follow you on X.

Will third party applications still be able to stream via API to X Live?

Yes, streaming via third-party API apps will work on X.

Repost FAQs

  1. Help Center
  2. Posts
  3. Repost FAQs

Repost FAQs

  1. Help Center
  2. Posts
What is a Repost?
  • A Repost is a reposting of a post. X’s Repost feature helps you and others quickly share that post with all of your followers. You can Repost your own posts or posts from someone else.
  • Sometimes people type “RT” at the beginning of a post to indicate that they are re-posting someone else’s content. This isn’t an official X command or feature, but signifies that they are quoting another person’s post.
What does a Repost look like?
  • Reposts look like normal posts with the author’s name and username next to it, but are distinguished by the Repost icon  and the name of the person who reposted the post. If you see content from someone you do not follow in your timeline, look for Reposted by info in the post—the reposter should be someone you follow.

Note: Reposts may appear differently in third-party applications, and will show up in apps only if they are using X’s Repost API. Many apps have built in their own version of reposting—those posts are not treated as official reposts on X. To test, try reposting from a third-party app, then check your profile on the web.

Where do Reposts appear?

Posts reposted by other people:

  • You can see posts people you follow have reposted and quote posted in your Home timeline.
  • Repost and Quote posts, like regular posts, will not show up from accounts you have blocked.

Your posts that others have reposted and quote posted:

  • Go to your Notifications tab. There you will see all activity concerning your posts—including which have recently been reposted and by whom.
  • From the post detail page, you’ll be able to see how many Reposts of your post there are, in additon to how many quote posts there are.
    • To view who reposted you, tap the Reposts tab.
    • To view who quote posted you, tap the Quote posts tab.
How do I turn Reposts off?
  • You can turn off Reposts for a specific account if you don’t like what they share. Select Turn off Reposts from an account profile page to stop seeing posts they’ve Reposted (tap the gear icon  on iOS or click or tap the overflow icon  on web and Android).
  • Turning reposts on or off is not retroactive, meaning that you can’t remove reposts that are already in your timeline.
  • It is not possible to turn off ALL reposts from ALL accounts.
How can I undo or delete my Repost?
  • You can undo a Repost you’ve made by clicking on the highlighted Repost icon  in the post. This will remove the Repost from your timeline, but will not delete the original post.
Why can I no longer see my Repost?
  • If the original post was deleted by its author or otherwise removed from the service, or if the original post author’s account was deleted or suspended, your Repost will no longer be available.
Why can’t some posts be Reposted?
  • If you see the lock icon  next to someone’s name on their profile page or on their posts, their posts are protected and you will not be able to Repost their content.
  • If your posts are protected, you can still repost and Quote post. Only people you have allowed to follow you will be able to view them.
  • You can see protected posts from an account you follow in your timeline because that account has accepted your follow request, but because they have chosen not to share their posts publicly, their posts cannot be reposted by you or anyone else.
Are there limits on Reposts?
  • There is no limit to the number of times a post can be reposted, but X will only show up to the most recent 100 people who reposted any public post.
  • Reposts are counted toward your 1,000 posts per day limit.

Search result FAQs

  1. Help Center
  2. Search and trends
What are “top” posts?

When you search on x.com and on the X for iOS and Android apps, you can filter your results by clicking or tapping Top, Latest, People, Media, or Lists (located at the top of your search results). Selecting Top shows posts you are likely to care about most first.

Note: Top posts are selected through an algorithm, we do not manually curate search results.

Why don’t I see the posts I like in top posts?

Top posts are the most relevant posts for your search. We determine relevance based on the popularity of a post (e.g., when a lot of people are interacting with or sharing via reposts and replies), the keywords it contains, and many other factors. If posts you love aren’t showing up as top posts, it means they may not be the most relevant results for your search. You can tap Latest to see the most recently-posted posts matching your query.

How can I make these top results go away, or come back?

You can change the type of search results you see by clicking or tapping the filters at the top of your search results.

How does safe search affect my results in top and latest?

X’s safe search mode excludes potentially sensitive content, along with accounts you may have muted or blocked, from search results in both Top and Latest. Top shows posts based on relevance, whereas Latest displays results in chronological order.

To learn more about filtering your search results, including how to disable or enable safe search, read about how to use X search.

Why show top posts if they’re not the most recent results for my search?

Some older results may be highlighted at the top because they have been determined to be of high value for your query. Our search algorithm has found those posts to be particularly relevant to the subject you’re looking for, even though they may not be the most recent posts. Select Latest to view the rest of your search results in real-time order.

How are posts selected for the other filters?

Click or tap People to see results of accounts that match your search query. Click or tap Media to see to top images and videos of popular media related to your search query. Results are determined much in the same way as top posts.

What are X search rate limits?

In order to control abuse, X limits how often you can search from a single network address.

If you access X from a corporation, event or conference, you may be sharing the same network address with many people. In some of these cases, you may run into an issue with X search rate limiting.

How to set up your X account

After you Sign up for X, the next step is to set up your account by following the steps below:

  1. Customize your profile, including picking a profile photo and header.
  2. Add a bio.
  3. Set up your timeline by following people or Topics.
  4. post!
Tips for picking a username
  • Your username, also known as a “handle,” is the name your followers use when sending replies, mentions, and Direct Messages.
  • It will also form the URL of your X profile page. We’ll provide a few available suggestions when you sign up, but feel free to choose your own. You can change your username in your account settings at any time, as long as the new username is not already taken.
  • Usernames must be fewer than 15 characters in length and cannot contain “admin” or “X”, in order to avoid brand confusion.

Join the public conversation on X

A X account is your passport to what’s happening in the world and what people are talking about right now. By signing up for an account, you’re among the first to know about breaking news and what’s popular––from the funny to the uplifting to the surprising. If a topic is worth talking about, you’ll find it on X.

Some things to note:

  • You can sign up for a X account with an email address or phone number.
  • We’ll guide you through our sign up experience –– prompting you to enter information like your name and email address or phone number.
  • If you sign up with an email address, it won’t be publicly visible, but we’ll have you verify it through a confirmation email we’ll send you. And an email address can only be associated with one X account at a time.
  • If you sign up with a phone number, we’ll have you verify it through an SMS text message with a code. (You can also request a voice call to verify your phone number.)
I have an X account now! What’s next?
  1. Follow our official account, @Support. You’ll be the first to hear about product news, how-tos, and announcements.
  2. Follow some Topics. It’s a great way to create a customized X experience for yourself.
  3. Find and follow news sources, friends, more on X. When you follow an account, you’ll see their posts through your X Home timeline. You can unfollow anyone at any time.
  4. Customize settings for your new account.

Ready for more? We’ve got everything you need to know about using X.

Stay informed about important national and global events

  1. Help Center

What’s happening is replacing Happening Now on X.com and will help you stay informed about important national and global events. We created What’s happening so you are up-to-date with the latest news. What’s happening is curated content injected right into your Home timeline. For events that are highly newsworthy and in the public interest (i.e. COVID-19, elections, natural disasters), and where high-quality, trustworthy information is paramount, these will be inserted directly into your Home timeline. If you are not interested and wish to no longer see these events on your Home timeline, on X.com you can simply click on the  icon in the drop down menu in the upper right hand corner and choose Not interested in this.

Subscribing to newsletters on X

  1. Help Center
  2. Subscriptions

An update on Revue

We’ve made the difficult decision to shut down Revue on January 18, 2023.

In January 2021, X acquired Revue as part of an ongoing commitment to enhancing the X experience for writers everywhere. Our goal has always been to make it easy for these writers to connect with their readers and future subscribers on X, opening up new opportunities for readers to better connect with writers and their content. Integrating Revue into X has provided a huge amount of value, informing new product features that give writers more options for connecting with their audiences.

This has been a hard decision because we know Revue has a passionate user base. We’re grateful to everyone who has used our service over the years, and hope we can continue to help you build a community with your readers on X.

Keep up with your favorite creators who have Revue newsletters. Easily subscribe to a newsletter from the creator’s X profile or from posts.

Revue is X’s editorial newsletter subscription service. People who choose to subscribe to a Revue newsletter from a X profile will enter into a free subscription for that newsletter. If the creator’s content includes an option for paid newsletters, the subscriber can choose to upgrade on Revue by providing payment information at that time. Creators can control the display of the newsletter feature on their X profiles from their settings on Revue. 

Note: Signing up to receive or create Revue newsletters is subject to Revue’s Terms of Service and Privacy Policy. By signing up you agree to share your email address with the newsletter.

FAQs for readers

How do I subscribe to a newsletter on X?

On the creator’s profile, click or tap Subscribe. Or, to subscribe from your Home timeline, go to a Post that shows the creator’s newsletter and click or tap Subscribe.

Can I Post a creator’s Revue profile or newsletter issue?

Yes, you can share either a profile or a specific newsletter issue through Posts. When composing a Post, add the link to the creator’s Revue profile or to a newsletter issue you’d like to share, and X will automatically generate a link preview of the creator’s newsletter or Revue profile.

Can I read a preview of a newsletter on X before subscribing?

In your Home timeline, you can preview a newsletter from a Post that shows the creator’s newsletter. On the Post, click or tap to read a preview. You will then see the option to subscribe. If you already subscribe to the newsletter, you may not be asked to subscribe again.

How do I unsubscribe from a newsletter?

Click or tap on the Unsubscribe or Manage subscription link in any Revue newsletter email you receive from the creator.

Can I subscribe to other newsletters besides Revue from a X profile?

Currently you can only subscribe to Revue newsletters directly from a creator’s X profile.

FAQs for creators

How do I show a newsletter on my X profile?

Showing a newsletter on a X profile lets people subscribe to a creator’s Revue newsletter directly from the creator’s X profile. Once the creator turns on the subscribe feature in Revue, people on X will see a module on the creator’s X profile that invites them to subscribe. The reader can automatically use it to subscribe through Revue. The purpose of the subscribe from profile feature is to provide people on X with information about the creator’s newsletter, including the newsletter title, author, and subscription fee, if any. We do not permit this feature to be used as “clickbait” or for promoting external products or services, distributing offers or promotions, or similar activity.

Note: The email used to subscribe (including any email associated with a subscriber’s X account) will be shared with the newsletter owner.

Who can show newsletters on X?

Any creator with a X account connected to their Revue newsletter can turn on the feature to let anyone on X subscribe to their newsletter from X. Readers who would like to subscribe to a newsletter can use the feature any time they see it on a creator’s X profile or on Posts from the creator or others in their timeline.

Is there another way to share my newsletter on X aside from my profile?

Yes, you can share it through Posts. When composing a Post, add the link to your Revue profile, and X will automatically generate a link preview for you. If you want to show a specific issue of your newsletter instead, just add the link to the issue you want to show and X will generate a link preview of the issue. As with the  subscribe from profile feature, we do not permit this feature to be used as “clickbait” or for promoting external products or services, distributing offers or promotions, or similar activity.

How does showing my newsletter on my X profile work with my Revue account?

We’ve integrated the features so that you can show a link to subscribe to your newsletter on your X profile even if you don’t use X to log into Revue. Before connecting your X account to Revue (via the Integrations page on Revue), make sure you’re logged into X on a separate tab, then click or tap on Connect in the X card on the Integrations page. You can do this even if you’ve used your email address and not your X log in to sign up to Revue. You can change this setup at any time. Get help setting up and managing your Revue account. Remember that the purpose of this feature is to clearly and accurately share information about your newsletter with readers on X. As always, your use of this feature is subject to the Revue Terms of Service, including that the information you share this way must be current, complete and accurate. Improper use of this feature may result in suspension of your Revue account.

I logged into my Revue account using my X log in, but it looks like my content is gone.

You may be seeing this if you registered on Revue using your email address and a password as opposed to your X log in. Even if you’ve connected your accounts, it is not possible to log into your Revue account with X. However, this will not affect your newsletter showing on your X profile, as long as you connect your accounts in accordance with the Integrations page on Revue.

What if I have multiple X accounts and my Revue newsletter is connected to the wrong one?

You can connect your newsletter to a X account other than the X account you used to log in to Revue by visiting the Integrations page. First, you’ll need to click or tap Disconnect in the X card on the Integrations page on Revue. Then, go to X in a new tab on your browser, log out of the account you don’t want the Subscribe button to appear on, and log into the one you do want the Subscribe button to appear on. Come back to Revue, and click or tap on Connect now on the Integrations page. Once you’ve configured your Settings as described above, you can show your newsletter on your profile and this will appear on the most recent X account you connected. Learn how to switch the X account connected with Revue.

Super Broadcaster program on Periscope

  1. Help Center
  2. Using Periscope
  3. Super Broadcaster program on Periscope

Super Broadcaster program on Periscope

  1. Help Center
  2. Using Periscope

Important

Update as of Dec 15, 2020: Periscope and the Super Broadcaster program are shutting down on March 31, 2021. Learn more here. Broadcasters who meet the requirements here, can apply to be a Super Broadcaster until February 1, 2021.

What is the Super Broadcaster program?

The Super Broadcaster program allows select broadcasters who have applied and been approved to exchange their star balance earned from Super Hearts for cash.

Update: On December 15, 2020, we announced our plans to sunset Periscope. As part of this change, we have made some changes to when you can send and receive Super Hearts. Read more here. 

How do I apply?

Now through February 1, 2021, you can apply for the Super Broadcaster Program by logging in to your account at pscp.tv and going to www.pscp.tv/i/super/apply. Once logged into your web profile, you can also go to your profile drop down menu and select Super Broadcasters to access the application page.

To become a part of the program, you’ll need to complete a two-part application process: one part with Periscope and one part with our payments processor, Tipalti. For the Periscope section you’ll need to complete a questionnaire for our team to review. If you’re approved, you’ll be prompted to complete the Tipalti section. This second section will require you to submit payment and tax information.

You’ll also need to meet the following requirements:

  1. You must be a resident of: US, Canada, the EU, Argentina, Bolivia, Belize, Chile, Costa Rica, Colombia, El Salvador, Ecuador, French Guiana, Guatemala, Guyana, Honduras, Nicaragua, Mexico, Panama, Paraguay, Peru, Suriname, Uruguay or Venezuela.
  2. You must broadcast in English, French, or Spanish.
  3. You must have an active Periscope account for at least 30 days before applying.
  4. You must have a minimum star balance of 30,000.
  5. You must have created at least 5 broadcasts that are publicly available over the course of the last 90 days before applying.
  6. You must have an average of 50 live viewers and 75 replay viewers per public broadcast.
  7. You must not have any previous violations of our Community Guidelines and you must agree to abide by them and our Super Broadcaster Program Community Guidelines going forward.
  8. You must accept and adhere to our Terms of Service and the Super Broadcaster Program Terms.
  9. You must successfully complete the cash out application process.
How do I exchange my star balance for cash?

To redeem your star balance you must be part of the Super Broadcaster Program. As part of the Periscope sunset, we will allow ample time for Super Broadcasters to cash out all your stars before April 30, 2021.

Broadcasters will be paid out via our payments processor, Tipalti on a 30-day schedule using one of the following payment methods: ACH, eCheck, PayPal, or wire transfer. Please note that eCheck and wire transfer based payments may result in additional fees that the broadcaster is responsible for paying.

Our earning and payment cycles are aligned to calendar months (first to last day of the month). Super Broadcasters who meet the minimum cash out requirement will receive their payment after the end of the following payment cycle. Depending on the payment method selected, it will take up to six days for the payment to be fully processed and for the funds to show up in the receiving account.

For example, if stars are collected between September 1 and September 30, payments will be executed on October 31 and it may take up to 6 days after that for processing to complete.

Pay periods are based off a single time zone known as UTC. If your broadcast ends outside of the pay period according to UTC time, regardless of when it ended in your local time, the funds associated will not be paid until a subsequent pay period.

If you have questions specific to cash out transactions on your account, please reach out to us at superhearts@pscp.tv.

Our commitment to our broadcasters

Our goal is to support our community and give as much as possible to broadcasters. Starting with our November payments cycle, Periscope will only take a $1 cut per Super Broadcaster payout to cover the cost of processing monthly payments and to continue operating the Super Broadcasters program. All remaining earnings will go to broadcasters.

Payments breakdown:

  • 30% in-app purchase fees (Apple/Google)
  • $1 flat administrative fee (Periscope)
  • Remainder is paid to the Super Broadcaster
Super Broadcaster bonus

Super Broadcasters who earn one million or more stars per month are eligible to receive a $100 bonus. Super Broadcasters who earn three million or more stars per month are eligible for an additional $250 bonus ($350 total). Bonuses will be based on the earnings for each month— not the pre-existing star balance.

Where can I get answers about my coin balance?

You will be able to see your coin balance in the app; only you can see your coin balance. Also, you cannot see other broadcasters’ coin balance.

Since coins are purchased directly through the Apple App Store and the Google Play Store, coin purchase transactions must be reconciled between you and Apple or Google.

Where can I see my star and transaction history?

You can see your All-Time Stars by going to your Periscope profile and tapping on Stars. If you have star balance greater than zero, you can tap on Star History below your balance to see a history of the stars you’ve received with the date they were received and the title of the broadcast in which they were received. Only you will be able to see your star balance. Please note that you will forfeit your entire star balance when you post content that violates our Community Guidelines and your star value for broadcasts that you delete.

If you’re part of theSuper Broadcaster Program, you will see your All-Time Stars, Current Star Balance, and Cash Outs when you go to your Periscope profile and tap on Stars. You can also tap on Star and Cash Outs History below Cash Outs to see a history of the stars you’ve received with the date they were received, the title of the broadcast in which they were received and a history of all cash out transactions.

I lost my star balance. What happened?

You will lose your star balance when:

  1. You violate any of our Community Guidelines, Terms of Service, or Super Heart Terms. Super Broadcasters may lose their star balance if they violate our Super Broadcaster Program Terms or Super Broadcaster Community Guidelines.
  2. You delete the broadcast in which you earned the star balance.

If your account is permanently suspended you will forfeit both your star and coin balances.

How do I change my personal payment information?

You can update your personal payment information by logging in to pscp.tv and going to Apply (pscp.tv). At the bottom of this page you’ll be able to access a link that will allow you to update your payment information.

Topics on X

  1. Help Center
  2. Following and unfollowing

There are so many good conversations happening on X, it may be hard to find what’s most relevant to you from time to time. That’s where Topics can help.

Looking to follow a Topic?

From your profile menu, on your Home timeline, and in search results, you’ll see prompts to follow various Topics. Simply follow the Topic and we’ll personalize your X experience with relevant posts, events, and ads. We may also match you with other Topics that we think you are interested in based on your profile and activity, such as the posts you view or like.

  • How we select Topics
  • How to follow a Topic
  • How to unfollow a Topic
  • How to detach your accounts from certain interests
  • How to opt out of being featured in a Topic
  • How to see the Topics someone follows
  • Topics FAQ
    • Who can see my Topics?
    • Can I unfollow Topics?
    • If I see suggestions I’m not interested in, how do I show that?
    • How do I opt out of interests that don’t reflect what I’m into?

How we select Topics

There are numerous Topics across many categories on X to follow. We’re working hard to add new Topics all the time. How do we choose which Topics to offer? They’re based on the volume and health of conversations happening on X. For volume, we look at how much people are posting, Reposting, replying, and liking posts about that Topic.

We want Topics on X to reflect the broader, lasting conversations people have about the events, people, and things they discuss. So we use machine learning to find related posts from these conversations. This could mean they post a lot about the Topic or interact a lot with posts about the Topic. From there, we find the posts that are most interesting to those people, using algorithms, keywords, and additional signals.

We’ve implemented a number of protections to help keep conversations included in a Topic healthy and free from abuse — including working to not recommend posts for a Topic if the engagement is manipulated or spammy.

How to follow a Topic

From your Home timeline:

Step 1

While scrolling through your Home timeline, we may suggest a Topic for you to follow.

Step 2

Tap or click on the Follow button next to the suggested Topic to follow.

From your Topics menu:

Step 1

Go to the more icon and tap or click on Topics.

Step 2

A popup with options will appear.

Step 3

Tap or click on Topics.

Step 4

If you are following any Topics, they will appear here. You can select to follow more by clicking the Follow button.

Step 5

If you are not interested, you can select the  button and those Topics will appear in the Not Interested category of Topics. You can always choose to follow these Topics if you change your mind.

How to unfollow a Topic

From your Home timeline:

Step 1

In your Home timeline, navigate to a Post about a Topic you’re currently following.

Step 2

Tap or click on the  icon from the top of the Post and select Unfollow.

From your Topics:

Step 1

On mobile, tap Topics in your profile icon menu. On web, go to the more  icon and tap or click on Topics.

Step 2

Tap or click on the button next to the topic.

Up to 100 of your followed Topics are visible at a time in your Topics menu. To see all your followed Topics, and those we think you are interested in based on your activity and profile, visit Your X data.

How to detach your account from certain interests

On the X for iOS and Android app:

Step 1

Go to Settings and privacy in your profile icon menu, and then tap Privacy and safety.

Step 2

Below the Data sharing and off-X activity section, tap Ad preferences, then See your X data.

Step 3

You may need to enter your username or email address associated with your X account.  Enter your password and tap Confirm.

Step 4

From the Your X data screen, tap Interests and ads data.

Step 5

Tap Interests from X.

Step 6

Deselect any Interests you’d like to opt out of.

On X.com

Step 1

Go to Interests from X in Your X data.

Step 2

Deselect any Interests you’d like to opt out of.

How to opt-out of being featured in a Topic

On X.com

Step 1

Go to Interests from X in Your X data.

Step 2

Click or tap the Known For tab at the top.

Step 3

Deselect any Topics you do not want to be Known For.

How to see the Topics someone follows

On the X for iOS and Android app, and X.com:

Step 1

Go to their profile.

Step 2

Click or tap the more icon at the top of their profile page.

Step 3

Select View Topics.

Topics FAQ

Who can see my Topics?

Topics you follow are public. Anyone who can see your full profile can view the Topics you follow. If your posts are protected, only your followers can see your Topics. To protect your posts, go to your Privacy and safety settings and select Protect your posts.

Can I unfollow Topics?

Just like with accounts you follow, you can unfollow Topics at any time. Go here for steps on unfollowing a topic. We may still occasionally recommend Posts about a particular Topic, for example, if you continue to like, Post, or repost about it. When you unfollow a Topic, we will no longer suggest content based on the fact that you followed that Topic.

If I see suggestions I’m not interested in, how do I show that?

We strive to constantly improve your Topics experience and the suggestions we show you. We’ve made it easier for you to indicate when you’re not interested in a Topic we might suggest for you within your Home timeline and Explore tab. Simply tap the Not Interested selection in the suggested Topic prompt.

How do I opt out of interests that don’t reflect what I’m into?

You can always opt-out of interests by visiting Interests from X in Your X data. We won’t use that Topic to personalize your experience on X, and we will not recommend it as one you can follow in the future, unless you specifically search for it. Please note that these changes can take some time to take effect across our systems, and you may still see content about a Topic due to other reasons such as following someone who is talking about it.

We take the time to test

As we continue to build new Topics, including Topics that may involve more complex subjects and interests, we may take a cautious approach by only featuring a limited amount of accounts to start before adding more over time. We do this to test out the Topic and adjust our systems so we’re serving you the most interesting, healthy posts.

If you have a comment, question, or concern about the curated content you see on Topics, let us know. Give feedback

Undo Post

What is Undo Post?

Undo post is a X Premium feature that gives you the option to retract a post after you send it, but before it’s visible to others on X. It’s not an edit button, but a chance to preview and revise your post before it’s posted for the world to see. Once the Undo period is over, the post is viewable to your followers and you can either leave it or delete it, like you normally would on X.

  • Tapping Undo sends you back to the post composer where you can make changes before posting the post, or deciding not to post at all. You can also select Send now to skip the Undo post option and post your post immediately.
  • You can turn Undo post settings on for all or some of the different types of posts including Original posts, Quote posts, threads, and replies.
  • When active, Undo post displays a countdown of the time left until your default 30-second post Undo period expires, and your post appears on X. Shorten or lengthen the expiration window to 5, 10, 20 or 60 seconds under the X Premium feature settings menu.
  • If you turn off Undo post, you won’t see the Undo post prompt.

Read more about how to adjust the settings of your Undo post feature.

FAQs

Is Undo post an edit button?

Can I undo any post?

I need help with Undo post.

Where can I access Undo post?

Why can’t I see the option to Undo a post?

How do I undo my post after the notification disappears?

Why didn’t my post send right away?

Is Undo post an edit button?

Undo post is not an edit button. Undo post allows you to pull back and revise posts that haven’t been posted on X for the world to see yet. Once the Undo period is over, the post is viewable to the public and you can either leave it or delete it, just as you normally would on X. Posts that are already viewable to the public can’t be edited.

Can I undo any post?

You’ll have the option to activate Undo post for Original posts, reposts, threads, and replies before they are viewable to everyone. Leave your Undo post settings on for all or some of the different types of posts.

I need help with Undo post.

First, make sure you have the Undo post setting turned on. Eligible posts will show an Undo option after you send the post.

Select Undo before the post Undo period expires. This sends you back to the composer where you can edit or delete your post or save it as a draft.

You can always choose to shorten the Undo post period or skip the Undo option and post your post immediately by selecting Send Now.

Where can I access Undo post?

You’ll have access to this feature from a notification after you compose a post, and from the Home timeline during your Undo post period.

Why can’t I see the option to Undo a post?

X Premium defaults to a 30-second post Undo period, that’s managed and customized from your X Premium feature settings menu. If you choose to turn it off, you won’t see the Undo post prompt.

How do I undo my post after the notification disappears?

After you send a post, if you’re still in your Undo post window, you can undo or edit the post you sent from the home timeline or from your profile page.

Why didn’t my post send right away?

As an active X Premium subscriber, you won’t find a post you compose in your Home timeline right away because your features include an Undo post option that gives you a short window to edit your post before it becomes public. If you want to skip this intentional delay, you can turn off your Undo post feature in your X Premium settings, or tap Send Now to send immediately.

Is the app available for my version of Android?
  • The X for Android app is available for phones running Android OS versions 7.93.4 and above. Note: We no longer support older versions of X for Android. To experience the most up-to-date X for Android experience, download the latest version in the store or visit x.com in your browser.
  • Kindle Fire
  • B&N Nooks
I have multiple accounts. Can I be logged into all of them at once?

Yes! X for Android supports multiple accounts. If you have more than one account added, tap the navigation menu icon  or your profile icon in the top menu. Then, tap on the downward-facing arrow  in the header to access your other accounts. Learn more about managing multiple X accounts.

My Posts are protected. How do I view my follower requests?

You can approve/deny follower requests in the app:

  1. Go to your profile page.
  2. Tap Follower Requests from the menu to see a list of your requests.
  3. Approve the request by tapping the checkmark, or deny the request by tapping the X.
How do I remove the app or move it to my SD card?
  • If your device included X for Android as a bundled application, it cannot be uninstalled or moved to SD card.
  • The option to move to SD would only move the application itself (1.89mb), not the data while using the app. If on SD, the app will lose your login information.
Why isn’t my timeline automatically updated when I open the app?
  • Your timeline if the app is open or running in the background.
  • If you leave the app and reopen, just pull down to refresh the timeline.
  • This feature helps preserve timeline position when you close and reopen.
Is dark mode available on X for Android?

Yes, X for Android supports dark mode. To enable this feature:

  1. In the top menu, tap your profile icon.
  2. Tap Settings and privacy.
  3. Tap the Display and sound tab.
  4. Tap the Dark modeslider to turn the feature on.
  5. Choose Dim or Lights out by tapping your preference in Dark mode appearance.
  6. To turn the feature off, tap the Dark mode option again.
Can I change the font size on X for Android?

Yes, you can adjust the font size displayed on your X for Android app through your Android’s device settings. If you update the font size through your device settings and do not see the update right away, try restarting your app. Please note: It is no longer possible to update font size directly through your X for Android app.

X Handle Marketplace

We’re empowering active users to revitalize select handles which are no longer active on the platform, helping our actively contributing users build a stronger presence on X. These handles can now be requested on the Handle Marketplace by eligible subscribers, helping ensure our user base is easily navigated with relevant handles, leading to better engagement and growth.

To participate, you will need a Premium+, Premium Business, or Premium Organizations subscription. If your transfer request is approved, you get a limited, revocable, and non-transferable license to use the handle subject to the X Handle Marketplace Terms (“Terms”) and User Agreement (the X Privacy Policy.

Eligibility and subscriptions

To request and receive handles, your account must be in good standing, public, and comply with our User Agreement. Here’s what you need:

  • Type: For Personal accounts; Subscription: An Active Premium+ subscription
  • Type: For Business or Organization accounts; Subscription: Active Premium Business Full Access or Premium Organizations subscription

Account Age Must be older than 3 months

Account Authenticity Must show clear signs of authentic, ongoing content creation (e.g., original posts, regular activity, not just reposts/shares or promotional content)

  • If you are an Enterprise Premium Business customer, you may qualify for reserved allocations. See the section below.
  • Failure to meet eligibility can lead to denied requests or reclaimed handles, with no refund except as required by law.

For more on subscriptions, visit About X Premium or About Premium Business and Premium Organizations.

How to access the X Handle Marketplace

  • Log in to your X account.
  • Go to handles.x.com. You can also access the X Handle Marketplace by clicking the “Request an inactive handle” tab in Premium Hub.
  • Search for available handles from the same account you want to use it on.
  • Request an available handle.
  • Accept the X Handle Marketplace Terms.

If you encounter issues, contact support via the support tool at handles.x.com, accessible from the menu or bottom right of the screen.

How to request a handle transfer

Find an available handle in the Marketplace, then submit your request. You will need:

  • An eligible subscription.
  • Agreement to the X Handle Marketplace Terms, including ongoing content creation (see “Maintaining your handle” below) and compliance with X’s Rules.
  • For some handles: A transfer fee and an explanation of why you want the handle
  • Depending on the handle you’re requesting, you may be prompted to go through a short ID Verification process.
  • Most requests require at least 7 days for a decision, but depending on volume response times may vary.

Why requests might be denied

Handle requests may be denied by X, some common denial reasons include:

  • Ineligibility, e.g. missing the correct tier of premium subscription.
  • Policy violations or impersonation concerns.
  • Handle unavailability or reservation for other purposes.

Some listed Handles may receive multiple requests from a variety of users. We prioritize active, eligible users to help ensure handles drive positive engagement on the platform.

Maintaining your handle

Once your handle is transferred you must ensure you continue to meet the below criteria:

  • Create content regularly. If an account is active but the associated handle remains largely dormant – for example, where little or no original or engaging content is published – X may reclaim the handle.
  • Use the handle in a way that reflects the spirit of participation and expression on X.  That means active involvement in platform activities (replying, reposting, discussing topics) that help build a vibrant community for sharing ideas and expressions.  X’s intent is to ensure that handles remain available for active voices and creators who help advance the mission of the platform, not for speculation or inactivity.
  • Ensure regular activity on the platform, with a minimum of 1 device login within a 30 day period. For details, see our Inactive Account Policy.
  • Follow X’s Rules, Terms of Service, Purchaser Terms, and X Handle Marketplace Terms.
  • Users who did not pay a Transfer Price with their handle transfer must also maintain their subscription. If your subscription lapses, you have 30 days to reinstate it before we reclaim the handle. Non-compliance may lead to reclamation without notice or refund, except as required by law. Users who pay a transfer price for a handle only need the required subscription when they make payment, but do not need to maintain it after the handle has been transferred.

Failure to meet the above criteria may result in X reclaiming the handle without notice and without refund (except as required by law).

Please note that X owns the handles – you receive a limited, revocable non-transferable license to use them, subject to the Terms and X’s Rules and Policies.  X can reclaim a handle at any time for any (or no) reason, as outlined in the Terms.

Costs and transfer price

Many handles, like firstname-lastname combinations or multi-word business names, can come as a perk with your Premium+, Premium Business Full Access, or Premium Organizations subscription.

Some handles are invite only and require payment of a Transfer Price, which varies by handle. This is most common for handles with higher commercially-related value. All payments are final and non-refundable. Taxes may apply via our payment platform.

What determines the transfer price?

If a transfer price is required by X, it is based on factors such as commercial value alongside rarity, demand, and market dynamics. Typical fees may start in the 5 figure region (USD) and span into the 7 figure range (USD). Prices may differ by release method.

The transfer process

If approved:

  • Pay any Transfer Price and complete business or personal verifications, if required by X.
  • We will transition your previous handle to the newly approved one.
  • Your followers, posts, DMs, and settings are unaffected.

Your previous handle is frozen for a period of time, meaning it is unavailable to other users. As part of the transfer process you’ll receive a limited, non-transferable license to your new handle. X owns and can reclaim any handle as per the Terms.

Can I transfer the handle to a different account?

Requests on the Handle Marketplace must come from the account you will use the handle on. You cannot request a handle you intend to use on another account. Premium Business users can contact support via the support tool at handles.x.com, accessible from the menu or bottom right, for help with new account associations. Additional fees may apply for custom requests.

Reserved allocations for Premium Business Enterprise users

Enterprise Premium Business customers may be able to access exclusive reserved handles tailored to their brand or industry. Contact X Enterprise support via the support tool at handles.x.com, accessible from the menu or bottom right, to inquire about availability and custom allocations.

If a handle is unavailable

Unavailability could mean:

  • An active user still holds it.
  • It is ineligible for the Marketplace, like reserved or excluded per policy.
  • Other reasons, such as an ongoing review.

For some currently unavailable handles, you can use the “Register your interest option.”  We will then attempt to notify you if the handle becomes available for request in the future. Enable email notifications within your X account settings to stay informed.

Preparing for a handle change

A new handle might confuse followers. Old tags or links could break. Once approved, we suggest you:

  • Post an announcement about the change.
  • Update your bio and profile.
  • Monitor for impersonation or missed interactions.
  • For tips, see Change your X username at help.x.com

Limits on handle transfers

You are limited to one transfer every six months per account.  Note that if you change your handle after receiving a handle through the X Handle Marketplace, X reclaims the Handle you previously received through the X Handle Marketplace.

To revert to your old handle, contact support via the support tool at handles.x.com, accessible from the menu or bottom right. We will reclaim the Marketplace handle, which may again be made available to other eligible users to request.

Can I sell or transfer my handle?

No. Your license is non-transferable and for your use only. Attempts to sell or transfer will revoke rights, reclaim the handle without refund, and may result in X suspending involved accounts per our Rules. This includes the sale of the whole account to another entity. For any questions please reach out via the support tool at handles.x.com, accessible from the menu or bottom right of the screen.

Canceling participation

To release your transferred handle, contact support via the support tool at handles.x.com, accessible from the menu or bottom right. We will reclaim the Marketplace handle.

For subscription cancellation, see About X Premium or About Premium Business and Premium Organizations.

Troubleshooting and support

  • Request denied? Check eligibility and resubmit if needed. Our support team may reach out to let you know why your request was denied.
  • Payment issues? Review our Purchaser Terms at legal.x.com.
  • Reclamation concerns? Appeal via the notification email.
  • For help, use the support tool at handles.x.com, accessible from the menu or bottom right. Enterprise users can access VIP support.

Managing Premium Subscriptions

Managing Premium Subscriptions

Checkmarks

Help with Premium Features

Account Support

What is X Premium?

X Premium is a paid subscription that offers additional features to improve your experience. X Premium has three tiers: Basic, Premium, and Premium+, with more features included in each higher tier. The complete list of the features is here.

What are the requirements to sign up for X Premium?

All subscribers will be required to confirm their phone number as part of sign up and meet any eligibility requirements. For Premium and Premium+ subscribers, access to a checkmark comes with additional requirements. Learn more about checkmark requirements here.

How do I sign up?

To subscribe on the web go to x.com and select “Premium” from the side navigation on the left.

To subscribe on iOS or Android, go to the profile menu then tap “Premium”.

How do I sign up?

To subscribe on the web, click here or go to x.com and select “Premium” from the side navigation on the left.

To subscribe on iOS or Android, go to the profile menu then tap “Premium”.

How much does Premium cost?

Premium subscriptions are billed on a monthly or annual basis as follows:

  • Basic: Starts at $3/month or $32/year on web (or your local pricing and any applicable tax)
  • Premium: Starts at $8/month or $84/year on web (or your local pricing and any applicable tax)
  • Premium+: Starts at $40/month or $395/year on web (or your local pricing and any applicable tax)

X Premium is not available in all markets, and the price varies by location and any applicable tax. You’ll find the regional currency price information on web and in-app on iOS and Android. Learn more about plans and pricing in available countries here.

How do I switch tiers?

Upgrading and downgrading is currently supported on iOS, web and Android. How upgrading and downgrading works per platform is outlined below:

On iOS, if you upgrade to a higher priced tier, you will receive a partial, prorated refund for the remainder of your previous subscription if you switch tiers from the platform where you were previously subscribed, i.e., iOS. If you downgrade to another tier, your subscription and the associated features will remain through the end of the current billing cycle and then switched to the new subscription tier. When downgrading, you will not receive a refund for any portion of your previous subscription unless required by law. When downgrading, you will be charged for the price of the new tier starting at the end of your current billing cycle.

On web, when you upgrade to a higher-priced tier, your remaining credit from your current billing cycle will be applied to the new tier’s cost, and you’ll be charged the difference immediately. The switch takes effect right away, and your billing will adjust to the new tier’s cycle. When you downgrade, your current plan remains active until your current billing cycle ends, then switches to the new tier with its updated rate. You won’t receive a refund for your current billing cycle, even after downgrading, unless required by law.

On Android in the Google Play Store, if you upgrade to a higher priced tier from the platform where you were previously subscribed (i.e., Android was that platform), once you pay the new price, the subscription starts with the new product instantly. Remaining time will be prorated and credited to you. If you downgrade to another tier, your subscription starts with the new product instantly, and the next billing date will be delayed according to the value remaining on the previous tier, giving you a credit for the value you would have had under the more expensive plan.

Upgrading your subscription on the same day will not affect your Creator Revenue Sharing payout.

Why am I not receiving the benefits associated with my subscription?

You can compare your subscription plan with the features here and complete these troubleshooting steps. If you’re still missing features that are associated with your plan, reach out to Support.

Why are subscription prices different on mobile compared to web?

Subscription prices are different on Android and iOS devices due to application store fees. To get the lowest price, purchase your subscription via web.

Why can’t I register my phone number?

If you’re unable to register your phone number to your X account, it may be due to one of the following reasons:

  • If the same phone number is registered in connection with more than 10 accounts
  • If the same phone number is registered to an account that’s been deleted in the past 30 days
  • If the same phone number is registered in connection with a suspended account

Read more on our Phone Number FAQ.

Note: If you’ve previously blocked SMS messages from a 40404 number, we recommend that you unblock or try an alternate phone number from a different carrier.

What if someone else purchased Premium on my account?

If you have an unauthorized Premium subscription on your account, cancel your subscription, update your password credentials, and enable additional security settings. All actions can be completed via Settings.

Are refunds available on Premium subscriptions?

Unless you are switching to a higher tier, all subscriptions are non-refundable, unless required by law. That includes subscriptions linked to X accounts that have been suspended or that you can no longer access for any other reason. This includes situations where certain subscription features are temporarily or permanently unavailable.

However, if you upgrade to a higher-priced tier on iOS, you’ll receive a prorated refund for the remaining time on your previous iOS subscription. If you upgrade on web, the remaining value of your previous web subscription will be credited to your account and applied to future payments.

On Android in the Google Play Store, if you upgrade to a higher priced tier from the platform where you were previously subscribed (i.e., Android was that platform), once you pay the new price, the subscription starts with the new product instantly. Remaining time will be prorated and credited to you. If you downgrade to another tier, your subscription starts with the new product instantly, and the next billing date will be delayed according to the value remaining on the previous tier, giving you a credit for the value you would have had under the more expensive plan.

Note: Subscribers must contact Apple or Google directly for all app-related refund and cancellation issues.

How do I cancel my Premium subscription?

You can manage your subscription from Settings on the platform where you subscribed. Your Premium features will expire at the end of your billing cycle.

To avoid further charges, cancel your Premium subscription at least 24 hours before the auto-renewal period. Canceling won’t give you a refund for amounts already paid.

To cancel your gifted subscription, please message us at @Premium.

Note: If you subscribe to Premium and cancel your subscription, your blue checkmark will remain until the end of the subscription term you paid for, unless your account is suspended or the blue checkmark is otherwise removed by X for any reason.

If you need help with an issue related to X Premium, please DM us @Premium on X.

Note: When you DM @Premium on X, you might receive an automated response from the X Premium DM Customer Support Chatbot. Please understand that the chatbot may provide inaccurate information in some instances; use at your own risk. X does not offer refunds or any other services through the bot.

We may conduct a secondary review of and may reverse any refund based on misrepresentations, fraud, manipulation of our systems, mistakes, or for other business and legal reasons. In such instances, we also reserve the right to take any action we deem necessary, including, for example, cancellation of your subscription or action against your account. X is not liable for any damages or losses from chatbot interactions.

What are the requirements to receive a blue checkmark?

Only accounts actively subscribed to X Premium or Premium+ are eligible to receive the blue checkmark. Your account must meet the following criteria, among others, to receive or retain the blue checkmark:

  • Your account must have a display name and profile photo
  • Your account must have a confirmed phone number

Learn more about checkmark requirements here.

How do I get a blue checkmark?

Once you are subscribed to X Premium or Premium+ (any tier) your account will automatically be reviewed for a blue checkmark. This review can sometimes take several business days. You may also receive a blue checkmark if you are affiliated with a Verified Organization.

What is the difference between the legacy blue checkmark and the blue checkmark obtained through an X Premium subscription?

Previously, the blue checkmark indicated active, notable, and authentic accounts of public interest that were independently verified based on certain requirements.

Today, the blue checkmark means the account has an active subscription to X Premium or Premium+. Accounts that receive the blue checkmark as part of a X Premium subscription will undergo the X Premium and checkmark eligibility review and not the active, notable, and authentic criteria that was used in the previous process.

Do I have to purchase a Premium subscription to get the blue checkmark?

Yes. You must subscribe to Premium or Premium+ tiers, or become an affiliate of a Verified Organization to get a blue checkmark.

I’m a new subscriber, why is my checkmark missing?

It can take several business days for our team to review your profile and the blue checkmark to appear. Hang tight!

I’m an existing subscriber, why is my checkmark missing?

If you make certain profile changes, your account will need to be reviewed again by our team before the checkmark will reappear. This process can take several business days. Any of these profile changes will result in your account being re-reviewed: changing your profile photo, display name, or username (@handle).

What happens to my checkmark if I change my profile photo, username, or bio?

Once subscribed to the appropriate Premium tiers, changes to your profile photo, display name, or username (@handle) will result in the loss of the blue checkmark until the account is reconfirmed to meet our requirements.  No further changes will be allowed during this review period. Learn more about checkmark requirements here.

What do the gold and gray checkmarks mean, and what is the difference between them?

The gold checkmark indicates that an account is a Verified Organization and the gray checkmark indicates that an account is a government/multilateral individual or organization.

Learn more about profile labels and what they mean.

What do the gold and gray checkmarks mean, and what is the difference between them?

The gold checkmark indicates that an account is a Verified Organization and the gray checkmark indicates that an account is a government/multilateral individual or organization.

Learn more about profile labels and what they mean.

How do I edit a post?

You have a 1-hour window to make a limited number of changes to already-published posts. Use it to make updates, tag someone, or reorder the media you attached.

Edit post currently only applies to original posts and quote posts (not replies).

Is Premium ad-free?

The ad experience on X Premium varies by tier:

  • Premium+ Tier: Subscribers to the Premium+ tier will enjoy an ad-free experience across most areas of X, including the For You timeline, Following timeline, post replies, and profiles, ensuring a smoother and more uninterrupted content experience. Premium+ subscribers may occasionally encounter sponsored content.
  • Premium Tier: Subscribers see approximately 50% fewer ads in the For You and Following Timelines. As you scroll, you will see approximately twice as many organic or non-promoted posts placed in between promoted posts or ads. There may be times when there are more or fewer non-promoted posts between promoted posts. The reduced ads feature does not apply to promoted content elsewhere on X, including but not limited to ads on profiles, ads in post replies, Amplify Video ads, promoted events in Explore, promoted trends, and promoted accounts to follow.
  • Premium Basic does not offer a removed or reduced ads experience.

Premium and Premium+ subscribers will have access to this feature after their account has been reviewed for eligibility and the blue checkmark has been applied.

What impacts the visibility and engagement of my account?

At X, we’re committed to fostering an environment where freedom of speech thrives, but we also recognize the importance of maintaining a platform where content visibility and engagement are managed responsibly. Here’s how we approach content visibility and engagement:

  1. Engagement and algorithmic considerations: Our platform uses algorithms to determine content visibility, focusing on relevance, user interaction, and community interests. Engagement through likes, reposts, comments, and shares influences visibility, but we’re also mindful of artificial engagement. Activities aimed at gaming our system, like buying followers or engaging in coordinated behavior to boost content, are against our policies.
  2. Content labeling and visibility: Users can label their content, especially if it’s sensitive or adult in nature. Content marked as adult or sensitive will not be monetizable, and ads will not appear next to it. Users under 18 or those without a listed birthday will not see this content unless they adjust their settings. For sensitive content, we offer warnings before display, allowing users to control their experience. Learn more about Media Settings.
  3. Platform manipulation and spam: We’re vigilant against any form of manipulation. This includes creating multiple accounts for boosting content, engaging in reciprocal engagement schemes, or using third-party services to artificially inflate metrics. Such activities not only violate our rules but also undermine the integrity of genuine interactions on X.
  4. Monetization and content: Content that violates our policies, especially in terms of adult or sensitive nature, is not eligible for monetization. This ensures that our advertising and revenue models align with community standards.

This policy framework at X is designed to balance freedom of expression with the need for a safe, informative, and engaging platform. We encourage all users to engage genuinely, report violations, and use the tools provided to manage their content experience on X.

Why are some replies being marked as Spam?

Regardless of subscriptions status, all replies are still subject to compliance with X Rules. Replies may be marked as spam when unrelated to original posts, of low quality, or if we see behavior that violates our platform manipulation and spam policy. Please focus on creating high quality content that is responsive or does not infringe on these rules. You can find more information here.

If you need help with a subscription-related issue, please DM us @Premium on X.

How can I regain access to my hacked account?

You can submit a ticket here to regain access to your account.

My account was incorrectly suspended. How can I fix this?

You can appeal your suspended account here. Note that you cannot submit a ticket on behalf of another account.

How can I reach out to X Support?

For subscription-related issues, you can message us on @Premium. Support via Direct Message is only available to X Premium subscribers. Everyone on X can get help by visiting our Help Center.

If you’re a verified org, you can access your dedicated portal for help Settings (x.com)

If you’re experiencing an ad-related issue, you can message @AdsSupport. For all other matters, you can find the relevant support channels here.

Note: When you DM @Premium on X, you might receive an automated response from the X Premium DM Customer Support Chatbot. Please understand that the chatbot may provide inaccurate information in some instances; use at your own risk. X does not offer refunds or any other services through the bot.

Disclaimer: We may conduct a secondary review of and may reverse any refund based on misrepresentations, fraud, manipulation of our systems, mistakes, or for other business and legal reasons. In such instances, we also reserve the right to take any action we deem necessary, including, for example, cancellation of your subscription or action against your account. X is not liable for any damages or losses from chatbot interactions.

Managing your X Premium subscription

How to sign up for Premium

  1. Open the Profile menu on your app or the side navigation on x.com.
  2. Select Get Premium+ on your app or Premium on x.com.
  3. Select the tier, then select Subscribe & Pay button.
  4. If you haven’t already, you’ll be prompted to verify your phone number.
  5. Then, follow the in-app purchase instructions for iOS or Android and confirm your subscription payment on web.

Congrats! You’re now a X Premium Member! Your account will be reviewed, and if approved, you will receive a blue checkmark.

How to check your subscription status

  1. Navigate to the Profile menu on your app or the side navigation on x.com.
  2. Select Premium and then tap Preferences on your app, or choose Premium on x.com.
  3. You will see a card at the top showing your current Premium tier, with the text Manage on the right, indicating you’re enrolled in X Premium.
Customizing your Subscription features

After you sign up for X Premium, you’ll be able to manage your subscription and customize your Premium features from the membership page.

Where to find your X Premium Feature settings

  1. Navigate to the Profile menu on your app or the side navigation on x.com.
  2. On your app, select Premium and then tap Preferences. Under Early access to select new features and Extras, select the features you’d like to customize:
    • Undo post
    • Color theme
    • App icon
    • Custom navigation
    • Profile customization
  3. On x.com, choose Premium, under Customization and the gear icon  in the top right, select the features you’d like to customize:
    • Undo post
    • Color theme
    • Profile customization
Edit posts

This highly requested feature gives you the opportunity to make changes to published posts. Use it to make updates, tag someone, or reorder the media you attached. Edit posts currently only applies to original posts and Quotes. Once an author has replied to their own post, the original post is no longer editable.

How to edit a post

You’ll have the opportunity to make up to five edits in a 1 hour window. You can only edit a post from the same device you sent your original post.

  1. Compose and send a post, you will be notified that you have 1 hour to edit your post.
  2. Select the  icon in the top right corner of your post and choose Edit post.
  3. Make any necessary edits to the body of your post.
  4. Click the Update button to send your edited post.
Using Undo post

Undo post is available in the X for iOS and Android app and X website and is turned on by default when you subscribe to Premium. You can turn the feature on or off from your X Premium settings. When turned off, you won’t see the Undo post prompt, and your post sends right away. When turned on, your post is completely private during the postUndo period. Your followers won’t see the post until the Undo post timer expires or you tap Send now.

How to customize the post Undo period

  1. Navigate to the Profile menu on your app or the side navigation on x.com.
  2. On your app, select Premium and then tap Preferences.
    • Tap Early access to select new features.
    • Tap Undo post.
    • Tap Undo post timing.
    • Choose between 5 seconds, 10 seconds, 20 seconds, 30 seconds or 60 seconds.
  3. On x.com, tap Premium.
    • Tap the gear icon  in the top right corner.
    • Tap Undo post.
    • Choose between 5 seconds, 10 seconds, 20 seconds, 30 seconds or 60 seconds under Post Undo period.

How to customize which types of posts the Undo posts feature applies to

  1. Navigate to the Profile menu on your app or the side navigation on x.com.
  2. On your app, select Premium and then tap Preferences.
    • Tap Early access to select new features.
    • Tap Undo post.
    • Use the toggle to turn on/off the type of posts you want to undo: Original posts, Replies, Threads, Quotes, and Poll posts.
  3. On x.com, tap Premium.
    • Tap the gear icon  in the top right corner.
    • Tap Undo post.
    • Use the checkbox to turn on/off the type of posts you want to undo: Original post, Replies, Polls, Quotes, and Threads.

How to Undo a post from the notification immediately after composing

  1. Before you post, check your Undo post setting (it’s on by default if you haven’t turned it off).
  2. Compose and Send your post.
  3. Tap View post in the Sending post notification that appears immediately after you send your post.
  4. You’ll see your post displayed with a timer in the bottom left counting down your post Undo period.
  5. Tap Undo.
  6. You’ll go to Composer where you can revise your post.
  7. If you tapped Undo, revise your post in the post Composer and tap post.
  8. Once the Undo post timer expires, your post posts to your timeline, and is visible to your followers.

Note: If you’d like to undo your post after the notification disappears, but before your Undo post period expires, you can also access the Undo post option from your Home timeline (scroll to the top) or tap the home button 3 times.

This feature lets you pick how your X app icon displays on your phone. Choose from several colorful options.

  2. Tap Extras.
  3. Tap App Icon.
  4. Tap an icon for your X app icon.

Once you’ve finished writing, select post.
